title: Canary Wharf Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent treatment centres, and local support points for Canary Wharf and the Isle of Dogs.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR. Designated Major Trauma Centre. Approximate travel: from Canary Wharf (or Heron Quays / West India Quay), take the DLR to Shadwell or bus D3 north to Whitechapel Road (~2 miles north, ~20 minutes travel).
- Newham University Hospital, Glen Road, Plaistow, London E13 8SL. Approximate travel: from Poplar DLR, ~2.5 miles northeast via East India Dock Road (A13) and Barking Road, or bus 115.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Barkantine Urgent Treatment Centre, 121 Westferry Road, Millwall, London E14 8JH. Approximate travel: from Canary Wharf Station, ~15 minutes walk south along Westferry Road (~0.8 miles), or bus 135 or 277 heading south.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- Canary Wharf is situated on the Isle of Dogs, an enclosed peninsula surrounded by the River Thames. While defended by riverside flood walls and the Thames Barrier, prolonged storm surges pose surface water hazards. Underground shopping malls, basements, and subterranean transport interchanges at Canary Wharf and Heron Quays are susceptible to severe flash flooding during heavy rainfall.

4. Essential Supplies:
- Major retail units and pharmacies located in Canary Wharf shopping malls (Cabot Square, Jubilee Place, and Canada Square) as well as retail stores on Poplar High Street and Westferry Road supply drinking water, batteries, and first-aid provisions.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
